card.name: Frequency words before a time unit
card.fires_on: The word "once" (also "times" or a dose unit like milligrams) where the next word is expected to be a time unit such as day, week, or month, as in "once a week" or "times per day".

modes.label: Once before a period
modes.description: "once" in a dosing or frequency phrase, followed by a time unit like a week or every few days.
